evidence: Victoria: trauma and emergency care centre (about 60,000 cases a year) reported by Deccan Herald; no cardiac or stroke service found
Bowring: nothing confirmed in public sources
Jayadeva: 24h emergency and primary angioplasty (Wikipedia, WHO SEARO listing: 5 cath labs); no stroke service found
NIMHANS: emergency thrombolysis and 24h thrombectomy (2026 report); trauma is neurotrauma only (Indian J Neurotrauma 2020), so general trauma is not counted; no cardiac service
St. Martha's: listed as a primary stroke centre in the Angels stroke-initiative directory; nothing found on cardiac or trauma
Chest diseases institute: no relevant service
Child health institute: paediatric centre, not an adult specialty centre
BMCRI: not separately confirmed (Victoria trauma centre is counted under Victoria)
Baptist: one directory lists a cath lab with conflicting address and bed data; not counted
HOSMAT: 24x7 trauma centre with polytrauma team on its own site; no dedicated cardiac or stroke service
Aster RV: own site describes a biplane cath lab, round-the-clock stroke care and polytrauma care (self-reported)
Narayana: campus ambiguous (Bommasandra health city vs multispeciality sites); not confirmed for this table row
Fortis Cunningham Road: emergency with trauma specialists described (Outlook spotlight, self-reported); cath lab only in a directory; no stroke unit
Manipal Old Airport Road: own page says a cath lab is ready for emergency angioplasty; stroke and trauma not confirmed for this site
Sagar: only a listing site claims 24x7 emergency and trauma; not counted
KC General: Jayadeva satellite running round the clock with angioplasty (Digital Health News)
